# Frontend Next.js Rules

- This file holds cross-cutting frontend guidance only; domain specifics live in other frontend instruction files.
- Ask clarifying question(s) before implementation and confirm scope.
- Keep component responsibilities focused and avoid unrelated refactors.
- Prefer accessibility-friendly selectors, semantics, and form labeling.
- Avoid introducing new dependencies when existing libraries already cover the need.
- For behavior changes, add or update tests in the top-level tests strategy when present.
